title: aspidium pennsylvanicum
intro: Aspidium pennsylvanicum, commonly known as American golden-fern, is a species of fern native to eastern North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which have been reported to alleviate conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium pennsylvanicum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. However, further research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential applications of this plant in modern medicine.
